messages.subject: Problems with bfactor function
parts:
Dear all,

I have runned the code below (at the final, please find the warning message as well). When I do not consider the "SE=TRUE" option the code runs well. Any clues?I think that the problem is due to my model consider a random effects testlet structure for less items than the total item number.

Thank you very much (attached please find the actual item parameters file)

# Removing digital residuals
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE))

# R packages
library(mirt)
library(readODS)
library(readr)

# necessary inputs
n <- 3000
sigma2tau <- 0.8

# loading necessary files
# item parameters and testlet structure indication
m_inf_item <- read_ods("C:\\Users\\cnaber\\Documents\\Arquivos\\consultoria\\INEP\\CAEP\\2023\\relatorios e apresentacoes\\testlets\\Simulacoes e Testlet\\Item_Parameters.ods")
head(m_inf_item)
nI <- nrow(m_inf_item)

# Item parameters
a<-m_inf_item$a
b <- m_inf_item$b
d <- -a*b
c <- m_inf_item$c
testlet <- m_inf_item$testlet
#
ma <- cbind(a,a*testlet)


# Latent traits values
m_Sigma_theta_tau <- rbind(cbind(1,0),cbind(0,sigma2tau))
vtheta <- rnorm(n,0,1)

# Testlet Random effects values
vtau <- rnorm(n,0,sqrt(sigma2tau))
 
# Latent matrix requited by matrix
mTheta <- cbind(vtheta,vtau)

# Testlet structure

# Itens 4, 5, 6, 7
v_ind_testlet <-testlet

# Response simulation
dataset<-simdata(a=ma,d=d,itemtype="dich",
                 guess=c,Theta=mTheta)
mY <- dataset

# Model fit

# factor structure specification
specific<-c(rep(NA,3),rep(1,4),rep(NA,13))
# model specification
model_testlet <- "G = 1 - 20
                  PRIOR = (1-20, a1,
                          lnorm,-0.2058759,0.6),
                          (1-20, d, norm,0,10),
                         (1-20, g, norm,-1.3,0.7)
                  CONSTRAIN = (1,a1),(2,a1),
                  (3,a1),(4,a1,a2),(5,a1,a2),
                  (6,a1,a2),(7,a1,a2),(8,a1),
                  (9,a1),(10,a1),(11,a1),
                  (12,a1),(13,a1),(14,a1),
                  (15,a1),(16,a1),(17,a1),
                  (18,a1),(19,a1),(20,a1)
                  COV = S1*S1"
simmod <- bfactor(mY, specific, model_testlet,
                  itemtype='3PL', SE=TRUE)
